dedupe_keys.name: dataset from shake table testing of u shaped dry stack unreinforced masonry structures subjected to out of plane seismic action

description: More than 200 dynamic tests examine two half-scale U-shaped dry-stacked granite assemblies under two input signals. The release includes table motion, optical displacement measurements and restraint forces, with synchronised videos of selected responses. Its boundary conditions represent masonry with insufficient restraint at the top. The dataset is provided by Structural Laboratory of the Civil Engineering Department of the University of Minho through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2025. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED labels the resource CC BY 4.0, while DOI or repository metadata states CC-BY-NC-4.0. Applicable licence terms remain unresolved. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
